evaluation: E1 latent prediction + E2 CC/PH probes
model: FIP-DINO-WM V0 (frozen DINOv2 ViT-B/14, time-conditioned ViTPredictor)
note: This is a frozen-DINOv2 feature predictor; it is not an I-JEPA/V-JEPA EMA teacher and has no pixel decoder.

train_baselines.baseline_rule: global_mean uses the mean z_b over all train pairs; delta_mean uses the mean z_b for the exact train delta_days, falling back to the global mean for unseen deltas

sample_construction.rule: one row per (plot_uid, image_stem_b, pair_type) for span probes; overall table keeps the smallest-delta row per (plot_uid, image_stem_b)
